# taxmap

> AI-assisted, evidence-backed tax and special-assessment maps. Agents interpret
> records; deterministic MCP tools store, extract, validate, and build.

## Documentation
- [Documentation hub](docs/): choose between using a map and creating a map.
- [Use a map](docs/use.html): reader hub; no installation or AI agent needed.
- [Create a map](docs/create.html): project creator hub with agent-assisted,
  developer, and AI-agent reference workflows.
- [App user guide](docs/users.html): parcel search, district cards, calculators,
  sources, official amounts versus estimates, and map limitations.
- [Build with an AI agent](docs/community.html): install/sign into one CLI,
  ask it to download the repo and follow SETUP.md, restart, then ask it to
  create a project. Optional direct installers, project review, maintenance,
  and publication approval.
- [Developer guide](docs/developers.html): setup, models, tests, and deployment.
- [Agent playbook](docs/agents.txt): plain-text workflow and evidence contract.
- [Agent HTML guide](docs/agents.html): browsable tool-oriented instructions.

## Reference
- [Repository](https://github.com/Cocoa-County/tax-map)
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/Cocoa-County/tax-map/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [CLI tools bootstrap](https://github.com/Cocoa-County/tax-map/blob/main/SETUP.md):
  persistent personal skills and projectless MCP; stop for restart before
  city project creation.
- [Skills](https://github.com/Cocoa-County/tax-map/tree/main/skills)
- [Typed models](https://github.com/Cocoa-County/tax-map/blob/main/src/taxmap/domain/models.py)
- [MCP server](https://github.com/Cocoa-County/tax-map/blob/main/src/taxmap/mcp/server.py)
- [Concord example](concord/): unofficial FY 2026-27 research map.

Use live MCP schemas for exact parameters. The county bill and adopted roll
remain authoritative; model coverage and calculator estimates are limited.
